gcrosshair_params89 ABI 3 outline source package

Core files:
- include/gcrosshair89_types.h
- include/gcrosshair_params89.h
- src/gcrosshair_params89.c

ABI 2 shape additions:
- circle/ellipse
- square/rectangle
- diamond
- directional chevrons
- hexagon
- directional brackets
- open/incomplete triangle
- segment masks
- centered trace breaks
- shape rotation
- shape-size spread policy

Documentation:
- README.md
- SHAPE_RENDER_CONTRACT.md
- INTEGRACION_BLANK3D.md
- CHANGELOG.md
- VALIDATION.txt

Tests/examples:
- tests/test_params.c
- tests/test_shapes.c
- examples/example_style.c
- examples/example_shapes.c

ABI 3 outline additions:
- per-variant enable flag
- fixed-point outline width
- independent RGBA outline color
- public setter and resolver propagation
